title: Los Llanos del Orinoco: Joropo, ganado y poesía llanera
goal: Explore the vast savannas of Apure and Barinas, cattle culture, UNESCO intangible cattle work songs, and joropo music.
grammar: geografía de los Llanos, cantos de vaquería de la UNESCO y organología del joropo

items: Trace the climatic rhythm between flooded winter marshes and dry summer grasslands.
Analyze the ethnographic and lyrical value of the cattle herding work songs.
Deploy pastoral, folkloric, and musicological vocabulary (sabana, vaquería, joropo, coplero).
